# 1. SCOPE

This specification covers 6061-T6 aluminum-alloy flat sheet for general
structural and machined components. NOTE: This is a synthetic sample document
authored for cross-vertical pipeline validation. It is not a real ASTM standard
and must not be used for production engineering decisions.

# 2. CHEMICAL COMPOSITION

| Element   | Min % | Max % |
| --------- | ----- | ----- |
| Magnesium | 0.80  | 1.20  |
| Silicon   | 0.40  | 0.80  |
| Copper    | 0.15  | 0.40  |
| Chromium  | 0.04  | 0.35  |
| Iron      | —     | 0.70  |

# 3. MECHANICAL PROPERTIES

## 3.1 Tensile Strength

Ultimate tensile strength shall be not less than 290 MPa. Yield strength shall be
not less than 240 MPa at room temperature.

## 3.2 Elongation

Minimum elongation in 50 mm shall be 8 percent for sheet 1.6 mm and thicker.

# 4. HEAT TREATMENT

Material shall be supplied in the T6 temper: solution heat treated and artificially
aged. Solution treatment temperature shall be 530 +/- 5 degrees C.

# 5. DIMENSIONAL TOLERANCE

Thickness tolerance for nominal 3.0 mm sheet shall be +/- 0.13 mm. Flatness shall
not exceed 6 mm deviation per linear metre.

# 6. TESTING AND INSPECTION

Each lot shall be sampled and tested for tensile properties per the referenced test
methods. Certificates of conformance shall accompany each shipment.

# 7. EXPORT CONTROL

Standard 6061 aluminum sheet in this form is classified EAR99 and is not subject to
ITAR. Verify end-use restrictions for the destination jurisdiction.
